verdict.rationale: Pomelo is a card-issuing platform, so the agent-card axis applies. The evidence shows only generic issuing building blocks: virtual cards and blocking of specific merchants, categories or merchant IDs. Nothing documents issuing scoped cards to AI agents by name, nor per-card amount caps or expiry for autonomous purchases. Its MCP server is a docs and API-query assistant, not agent card provisioning, so the story is not delivered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can give an agent its own card — issue a scoped virtual card to an AI agent with merchant locks, amount caps, and expiry so autonomous purchases stay inside policy, a use the vendor documents by name
